anthropologists.linePrev: They checked out all the data on their list

psychologists.line: From speech therapists to child psychologists
stanza: I stopped talking when I was six years old
I didn't want anything more to do with the outside world
But of course they wouldn't leave me alone
My parents tried every trick in the book
From speech therapists to child psychologists
I could have anything, as long as I said it out loud
